Of course! Our 100-day risk-free trial applies to gifts, too. So if you're treating someone to a SURI, they can try it for themselves with complete peace of mind.

settings.repere: Bouton ou lien · Why should I choose SURI over other el…
settings.text: Why should I choose SURI over other electric toothbrushes?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · SURI brings together clinically-tested…
settings.text: SURI brings together clinically-tested sonic cleaning, thoughtful design and everyday convenience. With a pressure sensor, over four weeks of battery life, a slim aluminium body and innovative plant-based heads, everything is designed to make brushing feel effortless. No unnecessary extras, just a great clean you'll look forward to, twice a day.

settings.repere: Bouton ou lien · What makes sonic different from ‘round…
settings.text: What makes sonic different from ‘round headed’ brushes?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · A sonic toothbrush, like SURI, doesn’t…
settings.text:
A sonic toothbrush, like SURI, doesn’t only clean with its bristles.

As the brush head vibrates at high speed, it sets the fluid around your teeth in motion. That movement helps to lift away plaque in places the bristles may not directly reach, including between teeth and below the gumline. The bristles still do the heavy lifting, but fluid dynamics helps the clean go even further.

The familiar oval head shape and brushing motion feel instantly intuitive rather than a new technique to learn. And with a quiet sonic motor, you get a powerful clean without the harsh buzz of a traditional electric toothbrush.

You could see and feel the difference from your very first brush. Independent clinical trials found that SURI removes up to 5x more plaque than a manual toothbrush after just one use, and deliver 4x healthier gums in as little as two weeks.*

*vs a manual toothbrush.

settings.text: Fast. Smooth. Surprisingly gentle. The brush does the work with steady, continuous vibrations rather than a pronounced mechanical scrubbing motion. You guide it slowly around your mouth and let the bristles do the rest.

settings.text: Yes. Sonic toothbrushes like SURI are a great choice for sensitive teeth. SURI’s built-in pressure sensor helps you avoid brushing too hard, while medium-soft bristles provide an effective clean without feeling harsh on sensitive teeth and gums.
